minimal_page.purpose: isolates fixed runtime/GL cost from application content

windowed_minimal_page.conclusion: the windowed fixed cost (sokol_app + GL + X11, llvmpipe) is ~96-98 MB; application content adds ~2 MB

optimization.change: per-node style arrays sized to nx_node_slot_bound(doc) instead of NX_MAX_NODES (100k), and restyle resolves into the layout's own array instead of allocating a second full copy
optimization.note: headless numbers moved within run-to-run noise (JSC lazy compilation); the style-array saving there is ~40 MB of untouched address space, so it shows up as lower peak only when many nodes are styled

render_bench.note: CPU reference rasterizer (headless/goldens), not the GPU path; it bounds worst-case software rendering, not Sokol presentation cost

targets.detail: windowed peak 100.2-100.5 MB on llvmpipe under Xvfb. Fixed graphics-stack cost dominates (~98 MB of the peak); GPU memory is not included in RSS and is not measured yet (risk R4).

caveats: llvmpipe is a software GL implementation: its RSS is not representative of a hardware driver.
RSS includes shared library pages and the JSC VM; GPU memory is separate and unreported.
Measurements are single-process probes, not a statistically controlled benchmark; ranges over runs are reported above.
No claim is made about Windows/Android/iOS memory until those builds exist.
